awExpenses, rawWallets, rawWalletTransactions, rawTransfers, rawBudgets, rawSavingsGoals, rawEmergencyFund] = await Promise.all([
          getExpenses(localUserId),
          getWallets(localUserId),
          getWalletTransactions(localUserId),
          getTransfers(localUserId),
          getBudgets(localUserId),
          getSavingsGoals(localUserId),
          getEmergencyFund(localUserId),
        ]);
        const nextCache = buildSafeCache({ rawExpenses, rawWallets, rawWalletTransactions, rawTransfers, rawBudgets, rawSavingsGoals, rawEmergencyFund });

        if (!isFinanceRefreshRevisionCurrent(requestRevision)) {
          return { ...nextCache, stale: true };
        }

        financialDataCache = nextCache;
        hydrateFromCache(nextCache);
        return nextCache;
      } catch (loadError) {
        console.error("CLARA offline finance refresh error:", loadError);
        const fallbackCache = { ...createEmptyFinancialCache(cacheKey), loaded: true, hydrated: true, error: loadError };

        if (!isFinanceRefreshRevisionCurrent(requestRevision)) {
          return { ...fallbackCache, stale: true };
        }

        financialDataCache = fallbackCache;
        hydrateFromCache(fallbackCache);
        return fallbackCache;
      } finally {
        if (loadingPromiseRef.current === promise) loadingPromiseRef.current = null;
        if (mountedRef.current && isFinanceRefreshRevisionCurrent(requestRevision)) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    })();

    loadingPromiseRef.current = promise;
    return promise;
  }, [buildSafeCache, cacheKey, hydrateFromCache, localUserId]);''',
    )
    replace_regex(
        path,
        r'  useEffect\(\(\) => \{\n    const bumpFinanceUser = \(\) => \{.*?\n  \}, \[\]\);',
        r'''  useEffect(() => {
    const handleFinanceUpdate = (event) => {
      const budgetOnly = event?.detail?.scope === "budget";
      const operationId = String(event?.detail?.operationId || "");

      if (budgetOnly && operationId && lastBudgetResetOperationRef.current === operationId) {
        return;
      }
      if (budgetOnly && operationId) {
        lastBudgetResetOperationRef.current = operationId;
      }

      bumpFinanceRefreshRevision();
      loadingPromiseRef.current = null;

      if (budgetOnly) {
        financialDataCache = applyBudgetNoPlanToFinanceCache({
          ...financialDataCache,
          key: cacheKey,
        });
        setBudgets([]);
        void loadAll({ background: true });
        return;
      }

      financialDataCache = createEmptyFinancialCache();
      setFinanceUserVersion((version) => version + 1);
    };

    const events = [
      "clara:demo-data-loaded",
      "clara:finance-data-updated",
      "clara-finance-updated",
      "clara-local-finance-updated",
      "clara-budgets-updated",
      "storage",
    ];
    events.forEach((eventName) => window.addEventListener(eventName, handleFinanceUpdate));
    return () => events.forEach((eventName) => window.removeEventListener(eventName, handleFinanceUpdate));
  }, [cacheKey, loadAll]);''',
    )
    replace_required(path, '    loading, refreshing, error,\n', '    loading, refreshing, error, localUserId,\n')
